decisions.reason: The award signals realized option value and low keeping costs justify waiting for further uncertainty resolution.
No market traction and overlap with the award-winning Product A suggest the option value is unlikely to materialize.
Without evidence of value creation as a standalone option, releasing resources is preferable.
Fire-protection profiles may hold regulatory-driven option value that is worth keeping open at low cost.
No demonstrated demand for slim profiles makes the option value too low to justify continued commitment.
Decorative surface systems lack traction and are less core to the firm's materials expertise.
